verdict.reasons: Identified the specific white-and-blue AFP drip-tape carton roll in the lower-left corner with clear branding. The scene correctly displays thin, flat drip-tape laterals with neutral seedlings and root-zone wetting, which matches the technical evidence for a 'tape20' product family and agronomy intent. The product is isolated on a dry soil island to the left of the lines, preventing any impression that the packaging itself is the installed hardware. The required watermark is present and legible. Minor imperfections such as slightly generic fine print on the carton and minor variations in the installed lateral lines do not constitute core defects and are accepted as advisory.
